verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents usage-based billing through usage-event ingestion. Its subscriptions combine plans with addons and charges, and its AI can draft plans, addons, charges and prices from a pricing page, which points to a no-code hybrid subscription-plus-usage setup. The evidence never names any specific pricing model or the credit and commitment mechanics. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of tiered, volume, graduated and per-unit pricing models; credits/prepaid drawdown; minimum commitments; overage pricing; independent corroboration of no-code configuration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can price with tiered, volume, graduated, per-unit, and hybrid subscription-plus-usage models — including credits, commitments, and overage — without custom code

citations.quote: This resource allows you to record usage events, which are essential for usage-based billing.
Optionally, it can also incorporate one or more associated addons, charges, coupons, and discounts.
Let Chargebee AI draft product families, plans, addons, charges, prices, features, and entitlements from a pricing page, document, or description.
